## Our Services


Clear, calm financial support designed for small business owners, freelancers, and startup founders who need expert bookkeeping without the corporate noise.









Core Service

### Monthly Bookkeeping


We handle your day-to-day financial records with meticulous care, ensuring every transaction is categorized correctly so you always have a clear, up-to-date picture of your business health.


Ideal for busy founders and freelancers who want to stay tax-ready without the stress of DIY spreadsheets.















Cleanup

### Financial Organization & Cleanup


Behind on your books? We specialize in untangling messy records, reconciling accounts, and setting up clean, efficient systems that make sense for your workflow.


Perfect for growing businesses ready to move from shoebox receipts to professional financial clarity.







Insights

### Reporting & Decision Support


Beyond the numbers, we provide clear, jargon-free reports that help you understand profitability, cash flow, and trends—so you can make confident decisions about the future of your business.


Designed for owners who want a trusted financial partner, not just a data entry service.





















## How We Support Your Business


A calm, clear journey from messy books to confident financial clarity — guided by a team that treats your business like our own.








01


### Getting to Know You


We start with a relaxed conversation to understand your business, your goals, and what's been keeping you up at night. No jargon, no judgment — just honest listening.









02


### Setting Up Clean Systems


We design a personalized bookkeeping system that fits your workflow. Whether it's cloud-based software or simple spreadsheets, we make sure everything runs smoothly from day one.









03


### Monthly Bookkeeping Rhythm


Each month we quietly reconcile transactions, categorize expenses, and prepare your records. You focus on your business; we handle the numbers with care and consistency.









04


### Clear Reports & Ongoing Support


Receive easy-to-read financial reports and insights that help you make smart decisions. And we're always just a message away when questions pop up — you're never alone in this.













### You're in safe hands


We believe bookkeeping should feel like a conversation, not a confrontation. Our approach is built on calm communication, steady consistency, and zero judgment — no matter how messy things feel right now. We've seen it all, and we're here to help you move forward with confidence.

# Bookkeeping That Feels Like a Conversation, Not a Chore


At SMN Bookkeeping, we believe financial clarity shouldn't come with a side of jargon. We provide consistent, human-centered support so you can focus on what you do best—running your business with confidence.








## A quiet, steady hand for your finances


Running a small business or freelancing means wearing every hat. The financial hat, however, often feels the heaviest. Our approach to small business bookkeeping service is built on partnership, not just processing. We take the time to understand your operations, your goals, and your worries, translating messy receipts and scattered transactions into a clear, organized picture.


Whether you need help untangling historical records or establishing a clean system for the future, our accounting services for small business are designed to grow with you. We don't just balance the books; we help you read the story they tell, guiding you toward smarter decisions with practical, timely insights.

Our Expertise

## Bookkeeping & Accounting Services


We provide comprehensive financial management solutions tailored for small businesses, startups, and freelancers. Our approach combines meticulous double-entry bookkeeping with warm, personal support so you can focus on growing your business with confidence.










### Monthly Bookkeeping


Stay on top of your finances with consistent, accurate monthly bookkeeping. We categorize transactions, reconcile accounts, and deliver clean financial statements every month so you always know where your business stands.


Includes bank feed setup, transaction categorization, monthly P&L and balance sheet reports, and proactive catch-up calls. Best for service-based businesses, consultants, and growing startups.









### Account Reconciliation


Ensure every transaction in your books matches your bank and credit card statements. Our thorough reconciliation process catches discrepancies early, preventing costly errors and giving you peace of mind at tax time.


Includes monthly bank and credit card reconciliation, discrepancy investigation, adjusting journal entries, and a summary of unresolved items. Ideal for businesses processing high transaction volumes.









### Financial Cleanup


Behind on your books? Our financial cleanup service brings order to messy records. We reconstruct your financial history, fix categorization errors, and set you up with a clean, audit-ready foundation going forward.


Includes historical transaction review, bulk recategorization, opening balance adjustments, and a handoff package with documented processes. Perfect for businesses catching up after a period of rapid growth or neglect.









### Reporting & Insights


Turn your numbers into knowledge. We prepare custom financial reports and dashboards that help you understand profitability, cash flow trends, and growth opportunities — translated into plain language, not accounting jargon.


Includes monthly management reports, cash flow forecasting, budget-to-actual comparisons, and quarterly strategy check-ins. Suited for founders and small business owners who want data-driven decision support.
















## Bookkeeping that works around your life, not the other way around


We know running a small business means wearing every hat. Our bookkeeping services give you back your evenings, reduce the anxiety of tax season, and turn your financial data into clear, actionable insights. Whether you're meticulously organized or catching up on a few months, you'll feel supported from the very first conversation.

Common Questions

## Bookkeeping clarity, answered honestly


We believe financial support should feel like a conversation, not a contract. Here are the questions we hear most often from small business owners and freelancers exploring bookkeeping services for the first time.












### Who is SMN Bookkeeping for?



We work with small business owners, freelancers, and startup founders who need reliable double entry bookkeeping in accounting without the overhead of an in-house team. If you value clarity, approachable communication, and a partner who treats your numbers like their own, you'll feel right at home.










### What does your bookkeeping support include?



Our small business bookkeeping service covers transaction categorization, bank and credit card reconciliations, monthly financial statements, and clean year-end reporting. We tailor the scope to your business — whether you need weekly catch-ups or a monthly deep-dive review — so you always have accurate records ready for tax time or investor conversations.










### How often will I hear from you?



Communication rhythm is something we design together. Most clients receive a monthly summary with insights, but we're available between cycles for quick questions. Think of us as an extension of your team — present when you need us, never hovering when you don't.










### Can we discuss catch-up bookkeeping?



Absolutely. Many of our relationships begin with a catch-up project — bringing past months or even years up to date before we transition into ongoing accounting services for small business. We'll assess the scope, give you a transparent timeline, and handle the backlog with care so you can start fresh.














### Still have questions?


Every business is different. Let's talk about yours — no obligation, just a friendly conversation about how bookkeeping can work for you.

Start a conversation

Our Story

# Bookkeeping that feels like a conversation, not a transaction


SMN Bookkeeping was born from a simple belief: that every small business owner deserves a financial partner who listens first and advises second. We built this practice to replace intimidation with clarity, one ledger at a time.


We know that behind every receipt and reconciliation is a person trying to build something meaningful. That's why our approach to double entry bookkeeping in accounting goes beyond the numbers — we design calm, organized systems that give you back your time and your confidence. Whether you're a freelancer tracking your first invoices or a growing startup managing payroll, our small business bookkeeping service wraps expert technical care in a warm, founder-led experience. No jargon, no judgment — just steady support from someone who genuinely cares about your success.

Work with us






















## The Values That Guide Our Practice


We believe that great bookkeeping is built on a foundation of trust, clarity, and genuine care. These principles shape every client relationship, every report, and every recommendation we make.











### Radical Clarity


Numbers shouldn't feel like a foreign language. We translate complex financial data into clear, actionable insights so you always know exactly where your business stands. Our accounting services for small business are designed to demystify your finances, not complicate them.









### Steady Consistency


Financial peace of mind comes from knowing nothing falls through the cracks. We maintain meticulous, reliable records month after month, ensuring your double entry bookkeeping in accounting is always accurate, compliant, and ready when you need it.









### Genuine Kindness


We understand that financial conversations can be stressful. Our approach is rooted in patience, empathy, and zero judgment. Whether you're a seasoned founder or just starting your side hustle, you'll always find a supportive partner in us.















## Who We Serve


SMN Bookkeeping supports different client realities — from irregular freelance income to growing startup complexity and everyday small business admin pressure. Our double entry bookkeeping in accounting approach adapts to your world, not the other way around.












### Small Business Owners


Running a shop, café, or local service means your books are the last thing you want to touch after a long day. We handle the daily admin pressure — reconciling sales, tracking expenses, and keeping your cash flow clear — so you can focus on your customers, not your ledger. Our small business bookkeeping service is built for real-world pace, not corporate complexity.












### Freelancers & Gig Workers


Irregular income, multiple platforms, quarterly filings — freelancing brings a unique set of numbers. We make sense of the ebb and flow, tracking every invoice and deductible so tax time doesn't feel like a scramble. Whether you're on Upwork, driving for a service, or running your own creative studio, your finances deserve the same care your craft does.












### Startup Founders


From pre-revenue to Series A, your cap table and burn rate matter — but so do clean books. We partner with early-stage teams to build financial foundations that investors trust, handling everything from expense categorization to investor-ready reports. Accounting services for small business shouldn't slow you down; they should give you the clarity to move faster.
















## Our Approach to Bookkeeping


At SMN Bookkeeping, we believe that financial clarity shouldn't feel intimidating. Our process is built around collaboration, not judgment. We work alongside you to understand your unique business rhythm, offering practical guidance and steady monthly support through our double entry bookkeeping in accounting practices, ensuring your records are always accurate, balanced, and audit-ready. Whether you're a freelancer tracking expenses for the first time or an established startup needing scalable accounting services for small business, we provide a calm, consistent presence that turns bookkeeping from a chore into a source of confidence.





### Collaborative & Judgment-Free


We meet you where you are. No complicated jargon, no shame about messy receipts — just patient, clear communication that builds trust and empowers you to make informed decisions.




### Steady Monthly Rhythm


Consistency is key to peace of mind. Our small business bookkeeping service delivers reliable monthly support, proactive reminders, and transparent reporting so you're never left guessing about your financial health.




















## Let's Start the Conversation


Whether you're ready for ongoing double entry bookkeeping in accounting support or just beginning to explore how a dedicated small business bookkeeping service can simplify your financial life, we're here to listen. No pressure, no jargon — just honest guidance tailored to where you are right now.

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  6/7/2026



SMN Bookkeeping ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: SMN Bookkeeping

- Email: niggemyer46@hotmail.com

- Phone: +17405820276

- Address: 103 Jefferson Ave, 43986-9802, Ohio , 43986-9802, USA



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  June 7, 2026



SMN Bookkeeping is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: SMN Bookkeeping

- Email: niggemyer46@hotmail.com

- Phone: +17405820276



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.

## 11. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
